proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our yard drops straight into the canyon. Elena's crew dug footings I did not think were possible on that slope, and now we eat dinner out there every night until the lights come on.
reviews.name: Marisol G.

reviews.text: We back onto brush in Poway. They explained ignition-resistant boards and ember gaps in plain words, pulled the permit and built to what the city wanted.
reviews.name: Craig F.

reviews.text: Near the water everything rusts. They used stainless cable and fittings and two years later there is not a spot on them. The view through the rail is the whole point.
reviews.name: Haley J.

reviews.text: Fence runs down a steep side yard. They stepped every panel so the top looks even from the street. The old one looked like a staircase gone wrong.
reviews.name: Victor N.

reviews.text: Original redwood deck from the seventies. They saved the good framing, replaced the soft boards and two posts, and it feels new without the price of a new deck.
reviews.name: Ruth A.

reviews.text: Pool fence and gate went in before the inspection. The gate swings shut and latches every time, even when my kids slam it. Passed without a note.
reviews.name: Derek S.

proof.guarantee: We check every footing we pour with you before the deck goes on top of it.
